tasks.title: Run one case several times
tasks.description:
In `src/stability.ts`, implement `runRepeated(c: Case, model: string, seeds: number[]): Promise<CaseRuns>`.

Call `triage(c.input, model, seed)` once per seed, in the order given, and return `{ id, runs, passRate }`:

- `runs`: one `{ seed, output, passed }` per seed, where `output` is what `triage` returned and `passed` is `output === c.expected`
- `passRate`: passing runs divided by all runs

An empty list of seeds throws an `Error`. The check compares every output with what `evals-triage-v3` answers for that seed.
nextSteps: Read `triage` in `src/triage.ts` and find where the seed goes.
Loop over the seeds and record one run each.
Compute the pass rate and guard the empty case.
hints: If every output for an ambiguous ticket is the same, the seed is not reaching the model.
Keep the seed in each run. Without it, a failing run cannot be reproduced.
A plain `for...of` over `seeds` with `await` inside keeps the runs in seed order.

tasks.title: Name what you see
tasks.description:
In `src/stability.ts`, implement `flagCase(r: CaseRuns): CaseStability`, returning `{ id, passRate, status, failingSeeds }`:

- `status`: `'stable-pass'` when every run passed, `'stable-fail'` when none did, `'flaky'` for any mix, even one miss in five
- `failingSeeds`: the seeds of the failing runs, in run order
- `passRate`: passing runs divided by all runs

A case with no runs throws an `Error`.
nextSteps: Collect the seeds of the failing runs.
Decide the status from how many failed compared with how many ran.
hints: There are exactly three outcomes, and only the two ends are stable.
Count failures once and reuse the number: zero, all, or something in between.
Do not use a threshold like "80% is good enough". A case that fails one run in five is the one you need to know about.

tasks.title: Report flaky cases instead of averaging them
tasks.description:
In `src/stability.ts`, implement `runStabilityEval(cases: Case[], model: string, runs: number): Promise<StabilityReport>`.

Run every case with seeds `1` up to `runs` and return `{ model, runs, results, flaky, stablePassRate, meanPassRate }`:

- `results`: `flagCase` output per case, in case order
- `flaky`: the ids of the flaky cases, in case order
- `stablePassRate`: the share of cases that are `stable-pass`
- `meanPassRate`: the average `passRate` over cases

Both rates are `0` with no cases. `runs` must be a whole number of at least 2; otherwise throw an `Error` that mentions `runs`.
nextSteps: Validate `runs` and build the list of seeds.
Compute the flaky list and both rates.
Run `node src/run.ts 5` and compare the two rates.
hints: `Array.from({ length: runs }, (_, i) => i + 1)` gives you the seeds.
Cases are independent, so you can run them with `Promise.all` and still keep the results in case order.
`stablePassRate` counts only stable-pass cases; `meanPassRate` sums the per-case pass rates. Guard both divisions for zero cases.
